rows.en: <library(1)><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>I had not yet told you about the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> in detail, so let me explain it on this occasion.

<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>The <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()><thumbnail(165)> is a spatial transfer facility developed over a decade ago by <book(9)>Federation<endbook()> researcher <color(6)>Jill Bardona<ce()>.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>In short, like the <book(30)>Boson Jump<endbook()> and such, it can move a specific thing across ultra-long distances in an instant.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Its greatest feature is that its core theory rests on a substance Dr. <color(6)>Bardona<ce()> personally discovered, "<color(6)>Baldora particles<ce()>."
rows.notes: "personally" avoids a gendered reflexive for Dr. Bardona.

rows.en: <operator(30030,1)><speed(2)><color(6)>Baldora particles<ce()> stabilize unstable dimensional distortions, and reportedly can connect separate spaces to each other.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>That is, rather than sending a thing across, it can create a <color(6)>wormhole<ce()><thumbnail(166)> that physically links far-apart places.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>However, in the final test 17 years ago, a <color(6)>runaway accident<ce()><thumbnail(167)> occurred.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>In that incident everyone involved vanished, and the developer, <color(6)>Jill Bardona<ce()>, reportedly went missing as well.
<operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>The key needed to start and stop the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> was lost along with <color(6)>Jill Bardona<ce()>...
<thumbdown()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>As a result, the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()> became an untouchable negative legacy, apparently left abandoned to this day.

uncertainties.issue: Developer surname Bardona vs facility Baldora: both are the provisional glossary/Encyclopedia spellings and they disagree with each other by design (open question in glossary.json). On screen "Dr. Bardona discovered Baldora particles" looks inconsistent.
Jill Bardona gender in glossary.json is "male" but its source id is berkt_ja (looks like a copy error from the Berkt entry); avoided all pronouns.
"negative legacy" is literal for fu no isan.

checked_decisions: Slot 20 ruling: "Jill Bardona" / "Baldora Drive" / "Baldora particles" kept per orchestrator decision; matches glossary.json and encyclopedia_022.
Slot 22 ruling: avoiding pronouns for Jill Bardona is right; "personally" correctly renders "jishin ga".
Slot 28 ruling: "untouchable negative legacy" is a faithful literal of "fureru koto no dekinai fu no isan"; kept.
Slot 21: "thing" for "buttai" avoids the j glyph; meaning intact.
Hearsay endings (sou desu / you desu) are preserved as "reportedly" / "apparently" in slots 23, 26, 28.
remaining_uncertainties: Slots 20/22: "Dr. Bardona discovered Baldora particles" looks inconsistent on screen; kept by orchestrator decision.
Jill Bardona's gender in glossary.json could not be confirmed by me; no pronoun is used in this scene, so no impact.
